answer: A five-person jury with 3-of-5 divergence slashes the bond, and dilution is the flaw: when the jurors disagree among themselves the quorum fails and the worker keeps the reward. The vine grows both ways. So each claim is also re-checked by an agent with no stake in the outcome, and that check is the shale layer under the jury. It cannot catch a farm whose clones all answer correctly. It only makes a lie expensive in the haven where collusion would pay.
